items.title: Saat kaç
items.situation: You are at the bus stop. A woman asks you the time. Answer her and talk about your day.
items.situationTr: Otobüs durağındasın. Bir kadın sana saati soruyor. Ona cevap ver ve gününden bahset.
prompts: Say what time your class starts.
Say what time you get up every day.
Ask her when the next bus comes.
promptsTr: Her gün saat kaçta kalktığını söyle.
Ona bir sonraki otobüsün ne zaman geldiğini sor.

usefulPhrases.en: It is three o'clock.
My class starts at four.
I get up at seven every day.
When does the next bus come?
usefulPhrases.tr: Bir sonraki otobüs ne zaman geliyor?

usefulPhrases.en: I am late every Monday.

items.title: Hava nasıl
items.situation: Your friend calls you from another city. Talk about the weather where you are.
items.situationTr: Arkadaşın başka bir şehirden seni arıyor. Bulunduğun yerdeki havadan bahset.
prompts: Say what the weather is like today.
Ask about the weather in her city.
Say what you do when it rains.

usefulPhrases.en: It is cold and sunny today.
I am wearing my black coat.
What is the weather like there?
When it rains, I stay at home.
It was very hot yesterday.

items.title: Bir arkadaşını tanıtmak
items.situation: You are with two friends. They do not know each other. Introduce them.
items.situationTr: İki arkadaşınlasın. Birbirlerini tanımıyorlar. Onları tanıştır.

usefulPhrases.en: Ayse, this is my friend Emre.
He is from Izmir.
He is a student at my school.
He likes football and music.
We work in the same office.

items.title: Bir fotoğrafı anlatmak
items.situation: You show a photo of your family to a friend. Talk about the people in it.
items.situationTr: Bir arkadaşına ailenin fotoğrafını gösteriyorsun. Fotoğraftaki kişilerden bahset.
prompts: Say who is in the photo.
Say when the photo was taken.

usefulPhrases.en: This is my mother and this is my brother.
usefulPhrases.tr: Bu annem, bu da erkek kardeşim.

usefulPhrases.en: They are in the garden.
My brother is playing with the dog.
It was last summer.
I am not in this photo.

items.title: Telefon numaranı vermek
items.situation: A new friend wants your phone number. Give it to her and ask for her number.
items.situationTr: Yeni bir arkadaşın telefon numaranı istiyor. Ona numaranı ver ve onunkini iste.
prompts: Say when she can call you.

usefulPhrases.en: My name is Deniz.
My number is five two one three four five six.
usefulPhrases.tr: Numaram beş iki bir üç dört beş altı.

usefulPhrases.en: Can I have your number?
Please call me after six.
I am at work in the morning.
